title: Indoor cat suddenly scratching furniture aggressively
content: My indoor cat recently started scratching the sofa and curtains every day even though she has a scratching post. Any advice to stop this behavior?

title: My dog refuses to eat after vaccination
content: My 2 year old golden retriever got vaccinated yesterday and today he seems tired and refuses to eat. He still drinks water though. Is this normal or should I bring him back to the clinic?

comments.content: It is quite common for dogs to experience mild fatigue and reduced appetite for 24-48 hours after vaccination. Monitor for vomiting, breathing difficulty or severe weakness. If symptoms worsen, visit your vet immediately.
